facts.text: Bill: Sustainable Harnessing and Advancement of Nuclear Energy for Transforming India (SHANTI) Bill, 2025 — introduced in Lok Sabha

pages.title: Karnataka Hate Speech and Hate Crimes (Prevention) Bill, 2025

facts.text: ⚠ Karnataka — first state to bring a dedicated law on hate speech and hate crimes

facts.text: Why: India has no statutory definition of hate speech
facts.head: News

facts.text: Grounds covered: religion, race, caste, gender, sexual orientation, disability, place of birth

facts.text: Offence: Repeat offence; Punishment: Not less than 2 years, up to 10 years, fine ₹1 lakh
facts.head: Punishment

facts.text: Nature: cognisable, non-bailable, triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class
